newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds traders sidelined by uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds traders sidelined by uncertainty.

text.p: UK meals and feeds traders were sidelined by uncertainty over the immediate direction of Chicago soybean meal futures.
A general lack of interest in trading at the present levels was an additional factor in keeping the market very subdued.
Soybean meal selling levels closed 1.50 to five sterling easier than Monday's finish, but if Chicago holds on to its gains, then higher prices are likely when the UK resumes business on Wednesday.
Rapemeal was completely neglected and ended the day with sellers quoting the same levels as on Monday.
